_comment: Eurelyas MCP server config (mcp-client-2025-11-20 format). Set enabled=true and provide an authorization_token (or $ENV_VAR reference) to wire in a connector. Tokens beginning with $ are resolved from .env at startup. Optional allowed_tools array restricts which tools are exposed. Restart Eurelyas after editing.
_auth: Get OAuth tokens via: npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector — connect to the server URL, run Quick OAuth Flow, copy the access_token.
